:::{#exm-neg-agreement-harmonic}
#### Negative agreement of the COVID-19 test as a harmonic mean

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the estimated negative predictive value is $9{,}207 / 9{,}214$
and the estimated specificity is $9{,}207 / 9{,}300$
(@exm-agreement-test-measures).
@thm-neg-agreement-harmonic gives:

$$
\ba
p_{\text{neg}}
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1}{9{,}207 / 9{,}214} + \frac{1}{9{,}207 / 9{,}300}}
&& \text{(harmonic mean of the two estimates)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{9{,}214}{9{,}207} + \frac{1}{9{,}207 / 9{,}300}}
&& \text{(reciprocal of a fraction)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{9{,}214}{9{,}207} + \frac{9{,}300}{9{,}207}}
&& \text{(reciprocal of a fraction)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{18{,}514}{9{,}207}}
&& \text{(add fractions with a common denominator)} \\
&= 2 \cd \frac{9{,}207}{18{,}514}
&& \text{(dividing by a fraction multiplies by its reciprocal)} \\
&= \frac{18{,}414}{18{,}514}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&\approx 0.995
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-neg-agreement-harmonic}

which matches @exm-negative-agreement.

:::
